actor_origin.api_server: receipt is emitted and committed by the request handler actor before switch
actor_origin.controller: receipt is emitted and committed by the controller actor before switch
actor_origin.triton: a dedicated collector process commits an official Triton COMPUTE_START receipt before switch; the experiment runner may only wait for and read the receipt

clock.projection: Unix-nanosecond actor evidence is projected only through the independent run anchor envelope

durable_effect.commit_timestamp: pg_xact_commit_timestamp is read through a separate PostgreSQL connection after the write COMMIT ACK
durable_effect.same_transaction: terminal entity, idempotency response, durable-effect causal event, and causal sequence allocation share one transaction/XID
durable_effect.timestamp_claim: the database commit timestamp plus separate-connection observation and process monotonic ACK/readback form a causal interval; no exact cross-host instant is claimed

metrics.model_unload_absence: absence is accepted only at the explicit post-unload checkpoint while the peer model remains present with the frozen identity
metrics.pre_unload_zero: controller and metric evidence are captured after in-flight reaches zero and before the actual unload call

run_set.contract: exact equality with the seven frozen profile/repetition sets

trace.join: request, trace, effect, offered and served model, generation, backend, run and attempt identity

implementation_constraint.postgresql: the existing dedicated control-plane PostgreSQL service enables track_commit_timestamp explicitly; MLflow and Airflow stores remain untouched
implementation_constraint.runtime: the prior qualification remains immutable non-credit history and cannot be promoted

supersession: all prior contracts and evidence remain immutable; this amendment is mandatory for every fresh acceptance attempt
trigger: independent auditor hard gate before the fresh Strict V4 matrix
